A [[Human/Legends|Human]] '''assassin''' employed by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Vul Isen]] tried to [[Death/Legends|kill]] [[Gar Stazi]] on [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]] around [[138 ABY]]. The [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] was killed by [[Jariah Syn]]'s [[amphistaff]], [[Heartstriker]].<ref name="Legacy 50" />
